ghi_chu: LO SO cua lo cham, cach nhiet tot (suy ra tu nhat ky PID chieu 2026-10-15, CHUA do truc tiep): Kh 0.8 C/phut (0.0133 C/s) o 100%, tre bieu kien ~200 s (dead 150 + lag 50), cong suat giu ~1.9%, dau do 0.1 C. Hang so nguoi suy ra tu: tau = (SP - phong) / (cong suat giu x Kh) = 9.5 / (0.019 x 0.0133) s = ~626 phut. Thay bang so DO THAT khi co.
